_comment: Optional generator config. With docs/product.md, docs/features.md, and docs/tech-stack.md present, defaults are enough. Run generate-module-map.mjs --init once to scaffold this file.

patterns._comment: Optional extra pattern catalogs. Primary pattern tuning lives in .plan-product/patterns/library.json and .plan-product/patterns/expectations.json. Bundled catalogs and the .plan-product library run first.

usage._comment: Local command usage capture. Raw JSONL is ignored by default; run generate-module-map.mjs --effectiveness to write a markdown report. Set enabled:false or PLAN_PRODUCT_USAGE=0 to disable.
